integrity: The proof is a symbolic induction from the published recurrences and bounds, with the finite base range evaluated from the published rank-7 linear representation. A standalone verifier replays that representation, checks the recurrences, performs direct finite factor enumeration, and tests a large regression range.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies equality cases for the three published bounds on the Thue-Morse Dyck-factor count. It does not classify near-extremizers and does not supply a new closed form for the full 2-regular sequence.
title: Complete equality cases for Thue–Morse Dyck-factor bounds
